import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    postings = inputs["postings"].copy()

    # Ensure correct dtypes / ordering columns exist
    # Sort exactly as cursor ORDER BY account_id, post_date, post_seq
    postings = postings.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "post_date", "post_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"  # stable sort to preserve any existing tie order
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    qty = postings["qty"]
    price = postings["unit_price"]

    valid_mask = (
        qty.notna()
        & (qty > 0)
        & price.notna()
        & (price >= 0)
    )

    # Compute post_value only for valid rows
    post_value = qty * price

    valid_rows = postings.loc[valid_mask].copy()
    valid_rows["post_value"] = post_value.loc[valid_mask]

    # Running total: cumulative sum of post_value within account_id,
    # computed only over valid rows, in the sorted order.
    valid_rows["running_total"] = (
        valid_rows.groupby("account_id")["post_value"].cumsum()
    )

    posted_totals = valid_rows[
        ["account_id", "post_seq", "post_date", "post_value", "running_total"]
    ].reset_index(drop=True)

    # Reject counts: one row per account_id that appears in postings,
    # even if reject_count == 0.
    all_accounts = postings["account_id"].drop_duplicates()

    reject_rows = postings.loc[~valid_mask]
    reject_counts_series = reject_rows.groupby("account_id").size()

    reject_counts = (
        pd.DataFrame({"account_id": all_accounts})
        .assign(
            reject_count=lambda df: df["account_id"]
            .map(reject_counts_series)
            .fillna(0)
            .astype(int)
        )
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )

    return {
        "posted_totals": posted_totals,
        "reject_counts": reject_counts,
    }
